$comment: Image CVE exceptions (ADR-0015 item 4). Each entry: id, image (postgres|keycloak|redis|caddy|otelcollector, or the release images api|bff|migrator, #119), package, justification (20+ chars), issue (#n), added and expires (YYYY-MM-DD, expires at most 90 days after added). Matching is exact. A component on the request path of a LAN-reachable service (Caddy, Keycloak and its Java libraries, the BFF, the Api) needs Marco's recorded approval, a reachability argument and an expiry of at most 30 days; Caddy has no exception without it (#120, G3 S-120-07). See docs/runbooks/ci-security-gates.md.

exceptions.justification: No upstream fix released (fix state: unknown). Deployed context (#120, ADR-0016 R9, ADR-0018): Postgres is on the internal pg-app and pg-kc networks only, with no published port, SCRAM-authenticated roles, no capabilities and a read-only root filesystem; its only clients are the migrator, the Api and Keycloak. The server binary links zlib, so this rests on exposure, not on the library being unloaded. NEEDS CONFIRMATION from the Grype match path and the CVE vector (G3 S-120-07): acceptable only if the vector needs attacker-controlled compressed input that no client sends; if not, wait for a fixed digest. Not renewed past this expiry.

No upstream fix released (fix state: unknown). Deployed context (#120, ADR-0018 D5): Redis is on the internal cache network only and reachable only by the BFF, with no published port, the default ACL user off, no persistence, no capabilities and a read-only root filesystem. Redis is not believed to link zlib (G3 S-120-07). NEEDS CONFIRMATION from the Grype match location: if zlib is loaded, the exposure argument above is all there is and the entry is not renewed. Not renewed past this expiry.

CVE-2026-54873, component libssl3 (OpenSSL 3.5.8, TLS and X.509 code); class (b), loaded but not reached. The Postgres server links libssl, but `ssl` is off in the stack (the image default, no `-c ssl=on`; S-120-12 guards it), so an SSLRequest gets `N` and no handshake or certificate parsing runs. Postgres is on the internal pg-app and pg-kc networks only, with no published port. Marco approved 2026-10-06; added 2026-10-06, expires 2026-11-02, 27 days. Renewed under #143: re-checked 2026-10-10, docker.io/library/postgres:18-alpine still at the pinned digest sha256:77f585114c32, no rebuilt image. Marco approved the renewal to 2026-11-02 on 2026-10-10.

CVE-2026-54873, component libssl3 (Alpine apk, OpenSSL 3.5.8); class (a), not loaded. Caddy is a static Go binary (CGO_ENABLED=0) that uses Go's crypto/tls, so it never loads the Alpine libssl3; the match comes from the apk database, not from the binary. The library can only be reached by a process started inside the container, which has no shell route from the network. Marco approved 2026-10-06; added 2026-10-06, expires 2026-11-02, 27 days. Renewed under #143: re-checked 2026-10-10, docker.io/library/caddy:2.11.7-alpine still at the pinned digest sha256:d8542f48d34a, no rebuilt image. Marco approved the renewal to 2026-11-02 on 2026-10-10.

CVE-2026-78659 (GO-2026-6603), Go standard library go1.26.8 in the Caddy binary, fixed in Go 1.26.9. Nature: HTTP/2 server memory exhaustion via Trailer headers (High). No Caddy release contains Go 1.26.9 or later or golang.org/x/net 0.60.0 or later as of 2026-10-17 (v2.11.7 is the latest release; the pinned digest sha256:d8542f48d34a is unchanged). Reachable once deployed: Caddy is the LAN edge and parses this input before any authentication; the stack is not deployed today (#132, #29), so the risk rests on time and on the deploy guard, and this entry is void once Caddy runs anywhere reachable. Time-boxed under ADR-0015 item 4 (#142), 14 days, expires 2026-10-31; `stackctl up` refuses while this entry is present, expired or not, until the Caddy bump removes it. Exception approved by Marco 2026-10-17 under #142.
